quotes.speaker: Pete Nance
quotes.summary_phrase: Pete Nance praises the consistent coaching messaging and concise game plan of the new staff.
quotes.excerpt: I think that that just makes it a lot easier to learn a new system
quotes.quote: I have it has been this is my third team, but I would say just like consistent messaging and detail, a real concise plan on what we want to do on both sides of the ball. And I think that that just makes it a lot easier to learn a new system when you are a new coach coming in. Like when there is consistent messaging across the board from all the coaches are all saying the same thing and teaching the same thing is it is really cool to be a part of so far.
quotes.social_post: Pete Nance says the consistent messaging and clear game plan from the new coaching staff makes learning the system much easier for the team.

quotes.speaker: Pete Nance
quotes.summary_phrase: Pete Nance explains how new, constrained practice drills help players think better during games.
quotes.excerpt: I think it just helps us think about the game more
quotes.quote: Putting us in different situations. A lot of the times we do just, you know, growing up or whatever we do a lot of the same drills, but changing the drills, taking one person out of those drills, having us do three on four stuff or whatever we are having to guard in tougher situations or having to do offense in stressful situations with constraints and we cannot do this or cannot do that and I think it just helps us think about the game more instead of just kind of the same drills we have been doing all our lives that are not necessarily conducive to the game.
quotes.social_post: Pete Nance explains how the team is using new, constrained practice drills to help players think more critically about the game instead of just relying on repetitive drills.

quotes.speaker: Pete Nance
quotes.summary_phrase: Pete Nance describes the current Milwaukee Bucks training camp as highly competitive and hungry.
quotes.excerpt: I think we have got a young, hungry group
quotes.quote: I think just a lot more competitive. You know, I think we have got a young, hungry group. You know, we have got some veterans, but everybody is for the most part is young in their career and still trying to make a big name for themselves. So it is fun to be a part of the competition that has been going on.
quotes.social_post: Pete Nance describes the current Milwaukee Bucks training camp as highly competitive, noting that the young and hungry group is eager to make a name for themselves.
